audit_semantics.EXACT_EXECUTED_REVERSE: The run itself executed an inverse/return/reassembly path and verified exact recovery.
audit_semantics.EXACT_PARENT_REPRODUCTION: The newer run re-executed and exactly reproduced the frozen parent solver/certificate counters before adding its own layer.
audit_semantics.RECEIPT_LINEAGE_CHECK: The relationship is established by immutable parent/base SHA and frozen receipt rather than by claiming one common byte-level inverse across different test families.
audit_semantics.REJECT_PRESERVED: A failed preregistered implementation remains failed and is not promoted by a later successful redesign.
audit_semantics.OPEN_SIDE_CONTROL: A side experiment localizes capability/cost without entering the direct promotion chain.

reverse_sequence.reverse_result: The local tombstone removes only repeated failed Buzz for the same residual handle. It preserved the exact baseline search trajectory while removing 1050 duplicate Buzz return checks, exactly equal to 1050 local tombstone hits.

The operator was active and reduced HAWKING_ESCAPE 2292->1174, canonical visits by 10372 and charged proxy by 804, but it changed the frozen trajectory to 2823 states, 603 absorptions and 452 polarity flips. Reverse audit therefore preserves REJECT.

Correctness and state trajectory stayed intact but canonical work did not decrease; the new route fingerprint added 2341138 charged edge visits, raising charged ratio to 1.6711404816904978. PT222 was correctly not run in this ladder.
256/256 reverse maps passed; 244 bytewise-distinct transformed forms recognized one frozen signed seed-signature class.
4096 raw residual states normalized to one state with 4096 normalization certificates and valid witness; no later stage invalidates these certificates.

The n=14 blocked-equality 16384-state fixed-coordinate cut collapsed to one explicit signed orbit with 16384 exact forward/inverse/witness lifts. This falsified that particular representation obstruction as a general P!=NP argument but did not supply universal polynomial discovery/construction.

Every accepted signed absorption used explicit forward/inverse Buzz replay; failures became HAWKING_ESCAPE and remained explicit. States fell 3591->2822, but canonicalization cost rose to 3488298 visits versus Q1 721682.
Q1 preserved Q0 admitted merges, states and resolution trajectory while reducing GT3..GT9 refinement edge visits 7841250->721682 (~90.8%).
Reuse required exact canonical CNF equality under an explicit invertible permutation; witness lift was tested. GT9 states fell 4001->2823, but typed-refinement overhead prevented a total-cost claim.

cross_lineage_findings.S_phallus_h_rule: S𓂸ḥ is a project-only reversible overlay; SOURCE and OVERLAY remain typed-distinct and the full anchor is authoritative.

reverse_reading.newest_to_oldest: S𓂸ḥ -> rn -> full external anchor -> durable provenance lane -> typed fragments -> recovery delta -> exact parent -> PT477-v3 local negative memory -> BH-Q2 exact signed return -> Q1 cheap prefilter -> Q0 exact permutation-certified quotient
reverse_reading.important_non_linear_note: PT222/C025 BLOCKED_EQUALITY is a separate frozen finite control family. PR184 and later certificate layers reproduce the PT477-v3 solver trajectory; they do not claim a byte-level inverse through the PT222 test object itself.
reverse_reading.preserved_failures: PT477-v1 and PT477-v2 remain negative; their failure receipts are part of the reverse chain, not errors to erase.
reverse_reading.structural_interpretation: The stable pattern is separation of proposal/compression from exact return proof: every successful loss/compression layer is bounded by a verifier, commitment, inverse map, durable record or fail-closed tombstone scope.
